short: The sister ship to the Bismarck, Tirpitz was a massive German battleship that tied down immense Allied resources simply by existing.
full:
Commissioned in 1941, Tirpitz was the largest battleship ever built by a European navy. Rather than raiding the open Atlantic like her sister ship Bismarck, Tirpitz spent almost her entire career stationed in Norwegian fjords. Serving as a "fleet in being", her mere presence forced the British Royal Navy to retain vital warships in home waters to guard the Arctic convoys bound for the Soviet Union.

Despite rarely firing her main guns at enemy vessels, Tirpitz was the target of relentless Allied attacks. She was repeatedly damaged by midget submarines and carrier strikes before finally being capsized in November 1944 by Royal Air Force Lancaster bombers dropping massive "Tallboy" bombs.
